excerpt: Veltrix AI connects QuickBooks, Xero, Shopify, HubSpot and more, and answers questions about cash, margins and revenue in plain English. From $49/month.
content:
Veltrix AI is a finance copilot for small businesses and their accountants. You connect tools such as QuickBooks, Xero, Square, Shopify, HubSpot, Google Drive, Google Workspace and Microsoft 365, which the site says takes about two minutes with no CSV exports, and then ask questions in plain English, for example why revenue changed. Answers cite where the numbers came from, say when data is missing and suggest next steps, and you can save an answer as a dashboard, such as ad spend against revenue or cash by quarter.

Each time you log in, Veltrix checks your books and flags issues like duplicate charges, figures that do not reconcile and bills open for more than 70 days. Access is read-only: it cannot change your books, move money or act on its own, and you can disconnect any source at any time. The site says it does not replace an accountant; it does the first pass and the accountant brings judgement. A free Business Health Check is also offered.

Veltrix is run by NetSky AI, Inc., which lists an address in Delaware, USA. Its About page names Manfred Swarovski as CEO and co-founder and Mykola Svystun as CTO and co-founder, with a remote team across the US and Europe. Plans start at $49 a month after a 14-day free trial. It has launched on Product Hunt more than once, including as Veltrix AI for E-commerce, and has 11 reviews there averaging 4.91 out of 5.

Veltrix AI launched on Product Hunt on 5 June 2026 and finished #4 for the day, with 242 upvotes and 47 comments. It has 11 Product Hunt reviews averaging 4.91 out of 5 (as of 14 October 2026). A second launch, Veltrix AI for E-commerce, on 2 October 2026 finished #2 for the day with 308 upvotes and 42 comments.

We have not tested Veltrix AI ourselves. This page brings together its official site, pricing page, About page and privacy policy, its Product Hunt listing and the official pricing pages of comparable tools, and says where each fact comes from.

profile.summary_short: Read-only AI finance copilot that answers questions about cash, margins and revenue from your connected tools
use_cases: Asking why revenue or margins changed this month without building a report
Spotting duplicate charges, unreconciled figures and overdue bills at login
Comparing ad spend with revenue for an online shop on Shopify or Square
Saving answers as dashboards, such as cash by quarter or top customers
Giving an accountant a faster first pass over a client's books

fit: run a small business or online shop on QuickBooks, Xero, Shopify, Square or HubSpot
want answers about cash and margins without building spreadsheets or dashboards
are an accountant looking at several clients' numbers (Pro and Enterprise add multi-workspace management)
not_fit: want software that does bookkeeping or pays bills: Veltrix is read-only
want an AI to replace your accountant: the site says it does not
need a cheap tool for occasional questions: there is no free plan after the trial

pricing.intro: Prices are from Veltrix's own pricing page, shown in dollars and billed monthly. Each self-serve plan has a 14-day free trial, and you can upgrade, downgrade or cancel at any time.

plans.name: Starter
plans.detail: 500 AI units and 10 Deep Thinking analyses a month, up to 3 data sources, 5 saved dashboards, 10 uploaded files; no team members

plans.name: Core
plans.detail: 1,000 AI units and 50 Deep Thinking analyses a month, up to 5 data sources and 5 team members, 10 dashboards, 20 files, one managed dataset

plans.name: Pro
plans.detail: 1,500 AI units and 150 Deep Thinking analyses a month, unlimited data sources, up to 10 team members, up to 50 dashboards, multi-workspace management, priority support

plans.name: Enterprise
plans.detail: Advanced permissions, multiple workspaces, client portfolios, custom data sources, onboarding and dedicated support

notes: AI units are used whenever Veltrix does AI work, such as answering a question, building a dashboard or customising a report.

alternatives.intro: Other tools that turn accounting data into reports and answers. Prices come from each product's own pricing page, checked on 14 October 2026.

items.name: Digits
items.what: AI-powered accounting software that automates bookkeeping, reconciliation and reporting
items.difference: Does the bookkeeping itself; Veltrix only reads your existing books and tools.

items.name: Fathom
items.what: Financial analysis, reporting, cash-flow forecasting and consolidation on top of Xero, QuickBooks and MYOB
items.difference: Built mainly for accountants producing reports for many companies; Veltrix centres on plain-English questions for business owners.

alternatives.more: General AI chatbots can analyse exported spreadsheets; Veltrix's FAQ says the difference is that it connects to your tools directly and shows its sources.

pros: Read-only access: it cannot change books or move money
Connects common small-business tools in minutes without CSV exports
Answers show their sources and say when data is missing
Flags duplicate charges, unreconciled figures and old unpaid bills at login
14-day free trial on every self-serve plan
cons: No free plan after the trial
Starter allows no team members and only 3 data sources
Usage is capped by monthly AI units

x.none: We found no posts about Veltrix AI on X yet.

faq.a: A finance copilot that connects to your accounting, sales and payment tools and answers questions about your business in plain English, with sources and suggested next steps.
Starter is $49 a month, Core $99 and Pro $199, each after a 14-day free trial. Enterprise is priced on request.

faq.q: Which tools does it connect to?
faq.a: Its FAQ names QuickBooks, Xero, Square, HubSpot, Shopify, Google Drive, Google Workspace and Microsoft 365.

faq.q: Can Veltrix change my books or move money?
faq.a: No. The site says access is read-only, it cannot act on its own, and you can disconnect any source at any time.
No. Veltrix says it handles the first pass and your accountant provides judgement and advice.
It connects to Shopify and Square and can compare things like ad spend against revenue; it launched on Product Hunt as Veltrix AI for E-commerce.
Digits for AI bookkeeping, Fathom for accountant-style reporting and forecasting, or a general chatbot with exported data.
